research.title: Physics 2.2 Speed and Velocity
research.treatment: Keskinopeuden vertailu koko matkan ja koko ajan perusteella; pysähdysaika ja hetkellisen vauhdin ero.
research.comparison: Adopt original whole-trip counterexample; reject advanced vector treatment as outside this KC.
research.ageContext: Secondary physics reference; Finnish concise lesson adapted to grades7–9.
research.usage: Conceptual reference only; no text or figures copied. Book licence must be checked independently before any verbatim reuse.
research.limitation: Does not demonstrate efficacy of our scenario or UI.

research.title: The Moving Man
research.comparison: Official landingpage retrieved, but dynamic teaching content was not readable in fetched page; do not claim full teacher-guide inspection or clone simulation. Original step/pause controls are a project design choice.
research.usage: No assets or source copied; reference only.
research.limitation: Legacy simulation not executed; no efficacy extrapolation.

research.title: Perusopetuksen opetussuunnitelman perusteet
research.treatment: Identifies authoritative national curriculum via ePerusteet.
research.comparison: KC placement retained from pinned canonical S5 mapping; this overview does not independently prove exact item thresholds or our sequencing.
research.usage: Link/reference only; no copied curriculum text.
research.limitation: Canonical KC mapping is project graph provenance; not newly approved by OPH.

research.title: Interactive Lecture Demonstrations — Interpreting Representations
research.organization: PhET Interactive Simulations / University of Colorado Boulder
research.treatment: Predict representation before observing the Moving Man simulation.
research.comparison: Adopt explicit prediction then controllable observation; reject importing position/velocity graphs and negative motion into this first ratio-concept lesson. Our straight-track trip examples are original, not the document’s numeric graph.
research.usage: Document identifies CC-BY with required modified-from attribution for modifications; no document text, graphs or assets copied here. Do not generalize that licence to every PhET asset.
research.limitation: Activity is a teaching-design comparator, not evidence of our learners or implementation efficacy.

Launch software review by Follow-up source review team; accountable integration by root: Keskinopeus käyttää koko matkaa ja koko aikaa, myös pysähdysaikaa.8/2 ja12/3 ovat molemmat4m/s. Pidempi matka ei yksin osoita suurempaa nopeutta. Myöhemmät vertailu- ja taukovalinnat linkitettiin malliin; lähtökysymyksen3m/s ratkaisu pysyy suljettuna. Sama matka lyhyemmässä ajassa ja pidempi matka samassa ajassa erotetaan; myös samat suhteet 8/2 ja 12/3 voivat antaa saman nopeuden. Koko tarkasteluaikaan kuuluva tauko on huomioitava. Vertailtavien liikkeiden tiedot ja vastaus kuuluvat yhteen; tulkintavaiheet sisältävät omat vertailuluvut. Nykyinen Lite vertaa samoja matkoja, aikoja ja suhdetta. Mallit koskevat annettuja yksiulotteisia etenemisiä; luokittelu ei osoita nopeuden omaa mittausta. Source and delta assessment only; technical gates and real teacher/learner validation are tracked separately. Evidence: docs/releases/launch/review-decisions.json. No teacher/learner validation or live release approval.

planning.teacherObjective: Keskinopeuden ymmärtäminen matkan ja ajan suhteena
planning.scope: Keskinopeuden merkitys; ei kaavamuunnosten sujuvuusarviointia eikä vektorinopeutta.
planning.assumed: Metri, sekunti, matka ja aika (PHY79-DIST-TIME). Jakaminen havainnollistetaan yhtä aikayksikköä kohti; ei piilossa desimaalilaskentavaatimusta.
planning.evidenceLimits: Practice is feedback for interpretation only; no mastery, retained recall or physical measurement claim.
planning.simulation: Deterministic straight tracks, x=distance*min(t/movingDuration,1); mean includes full own-trip duration including stop. One common playback clock starts both trips; each trip timer caps at own completion. Stopping early after a completed trip is distinct from the authored in-trip pause. Playback seconds equal simulation seconds; no decorative animation clock.
planning.assetProvenance: Supplied v2 generated raster reinterpretations from user package, unchanged pixels; original SVG diagram created here. No automatic licence assignment.
